svg.title: Ramps
svg.desc: A ramp rises 0.30 metres over 6 metres horizontal run, at 5 percent, followed by a 2 metre landing. A wheelchair user is on the upper landing. Truncated lower landing and ramp continuation show the adjoining route. Source claims: ramps. The example uses the existing recommended 1.2 m width. Solid base thickness and the manual chair/user (.72 × 1.20 m, 1.35 m seated height) are illustration assumptions. The lower landing length 1.6 m and following ramp length 2.2 m / rise 0.11 m are illustrative continuations with broken ends, not additional source requirements. Equal vertical/horizontal scales; this 5% example does not assert the separate greater-than-5% landing rule.
